options.name: advertiseondefaultpartition
options.description: Advertise VIPs from Shared VLAN on Default Partition

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: decrementhoplimit
options.description: Decrement Hop Limit by 1 when C(ENABLED).This setting is applicable only for UDP traffic.

options.name: dynamicrouting
options.description: Allow dynamic routing on this IP address. Specific to Subnet IPv6 (SNIP6) address.

options.name: ftp
options.description: Allow File Transfer Protocol (FTP) access to this IP address.

options.name: gui
options.description: Allow graphical user interface (GUI) access to this IP address.

options.name: hostroute
options.description: Option to push the VIP6 to ZebOS routing table for Kernel route redistribution through dynamic routing protocols.

options.name: icmp
options.description: Respond to ICMP requests for this IP address.

options.name: icmpresponse
options.description: Respond to ICMPv6 requests for a Virtual IP (VIP) address on the basis of the states of the virtual servers associated with that VIP

options.name: ip6hostrtgw
options.description: IPv6 address of the gateway for the route. If Gateway is not set, VIP uses :: as the gateway.

options.name: ipv6address
options.description: IPv6 address to create on the Citrix ADC.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: map
options.description: Mapped IPV4 address for the IPV6 address.

options.name: metric
options.description: Integer value to add to or subtract from the cost of the route advertised for the VIP6 address.

options.name: mgmtaccess
options.description: Allow access to management applications on this IP address.

options.name: mptcpadvertise
options.description: If enabled, this IP will be advertised by Citrix ADC to MPTCP enabled clients as part of ADD_ADDR option.

options.name: nd
options.description: Respond to Neighbor Discovery (ND) requests for this IP address.

options.name: ndowner
options.description: NdOwner in Cluster for VIPS and Striped SNIPS

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: networkroute
options.description: Option to push the SNIP6 subnet to ZebOS routing table for Kernel route redistribution through dynamic routing protocol.

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ospf6lsatype
options.description: Type of LSAs to be used by the IPv6 OSPF protocol, running on the Citrix ADC, for advertising the route for the VIP6 address.

options.name: ospfarea
options.description: ID of the area in which the Intra-Area-Prefix LSAs are to be advertised for the VIP6 address by the IPv6 OSPF protocol running on the Citrix ADC. When ospfArea is not set, VIP6 is advertised on all areas.

options.name: ownerdownresponse
options.description: in cluster system, if the owner node is down, whether should it respond to icmp/arp

options.name: ownernode
options.description: ID of the cluster node for which you are adding the IP address. Must be used if you want the IP address to be active only on the specific node. Can be configured only through the cluster IP address. Cannot be changed after the IP address is created.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: restrictaccess
options.description: Block access to nonmanagement applications on this IP address. This option is applicable forMIP6s, SNIP6s, and NSIP6s, and is disabled by default. Nonmanagement applications can run on the underlying Citrix ADC Free BSD operating system.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: scope
options.description: Scope of the IPv6 address to be created. Cannot be changed after the IP address is created.

options.name: snmp
options.description: Allow Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) access to this IP address.

options.name: ssh
options.description: Allow secure Shell (SSH) access to this IP address.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tag
options.description: Tag value for the network/host route associated with this IP.

options.name: td
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain in which you want to configure the entity. If you do not specify an ID, the entity becomes part of the default traffic domain, which has an ID of 0.

options.name: telnet
options.description: Allow Telnet access to this IP address.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of IP address to be created on the Citrix ADC. Cannot be changed after the IP address is created.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: The VLAN number.

options.name: vrid6
options.description: A positive integer that uniquely identifies a VMAC address for binding to this VIP address. This binding is used to set up Citrix ADCs in an active-active configuration using VRRP.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Enable or disable the state of all the virtual servers associated with this VIP6 address.

options.name: vserverrhilevel
